propositions: The O_EXCL stamped-file advisory lock acquisition and release logic is implemented identically in three separate modules (enrich_drain, compact_trigger, gc_trigger) with dangerous copy-paste inconsistencies in release semantics and logging behavior.

Release semantics differ between enrich_drain (single try block, leaks lock on os.close failure) and the other two workers (separate try blocks, always unlinks); the consolidated implementation must mandate the two-block form to prevent lock file leaks.

The drain's holder WARNING logging during reclaim is contractually pinned to doctor_locks' holder naming by test_drain_and_doctor_describe_a_holderless_lock_identically and must survive consolidation through a describe_holder callback.

Extracting stamped_lock.py will eliminate the duplication while fixing the drain's release bug, reducing net LOC and centralizing the stale-reclamation logic that depends on lock_owner.stamped_file_is_stale.
